title: Question 7.1e: Testing Individual Reviews - Comparing Results
instruction: After making a prediction, we compare it to the expected answer to see if the model was right.
reveal: This code converts the numeric prediction (0 or 1) back to text ("negative" or "positive"), compares it to the expected answer, and marks it with ✅ if correct or ❌ if wrong. It also increments a counter (`correct++`) to keep track of how many predictions were correct. This is a ternary operator (`condition ? valueIfTrue : valueIfFalse`) - a compact way to write an if-else statement.
